events.verdict: Jordan (LAC) and Beal (WAS) briefly engage and separate following the screen.
[Observable in enhanced video] Gallinari (LAC) splits his feet on the perimeter.
Mahinmi (WAS) briefly grasps Jordan's (LAC) shorts, but does not affect his FOM.
Scott (WAS) beats Gallinari (LAC) to the spot at the end of his drive and absorbs the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Jordan (LAC) fails to clear and is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Mahinmi (WAS) reaches in and makes contact with Gallinari's (LAC) arm that affects his shot attempt.
Beal (WAS) ends his dribble and takes more than two steps after his gather.
Gallinari (LAC) absorbs the contact from Scott (WAS) and maintains legal guarding position.
Jordan (LAC) sets the screen on Beal (WAS) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Williams (LAC) makes incidental contact with Mahinmi (WAS) that does not affect his ability to defend.
Jordan (LAC) makes marginal body contact with Mahinmi (WAS) that does not affect his shot attempt.
Jordan (LAC) sets the screen on Beal (WAS) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined that the foul by Satoransky (WAS) did not meet the criteria for a clear path foul and a common foul is assessed.
Williams (LAC) commits a take foul on Satoransky (WAS).
Mahinmi (WAS) makes contact to Williams' (LAC) hand and the contact affects his driving shot attempt.
Gallinari (LAC) makes incidental contact with Scott (WAS) during the screen.
Gallinari (LAC) sets the screen on Beal (WAS) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Jordan (LAC) and Gortat (WAS) briefly engage and separate without affecting each other's ability to retrieve the rebound.
Beal (WAS) briefly engages with Williams (LAC) off ball but does not affect his FOM.
Johnson (LAC) jumps into and makes contact with Bradley's (WAS) body during his driving shot attempt.
Beal (WAS) legally contests Williams' (LAC) jump shot attempt.

After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that 0.1 seconds ran off the clock prior to the ball being legally touched. Since the basket by Beal (WAS) was scored after the game clock expired, the Wizards retain possession on the sideline nearest the point of interruption and the game clock is incorrectly reset to 00:01.1 instead of 00:00.1, which is the amount of lost time.
Rivers (LAC) makes incidental contact with Beal (WAS) that does not affect his FOM.
Rivers (LAC) legally contests Gortat's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
